summary: Held curl at 7.76.1-31.el9 on node1 using DNF versionlock. The hold survived a node restart and suppresses the available 7.76.1-40.el9_8.7 update.
actions_performed: Verified an unlocked update would upgrade curl, while the active lock leaves it unchanged.
Restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed, the system recovered, and the curl hold persisted.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version during system updates
evidence.summary: The persistent lock targets curl 7.76.1-31.el9. Without the plugin DNF proposes 7.76.1-40.el9_8.7; with it active DNF reports nothing to do and curl remains at 7.76.1-31.el9, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery evidence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID was e65e6bcf-e09d-42b7-8317-cb6310086cb7; reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID was 5ad4724d-0511-4e33-b873-24ccf1dcd2dc. After recovery the system was running, curl passed RPM verification, executed normally, retained its versionlock, and remained at the held version.
